name: huggingface-hub
gap: The AI Store cannot list, classify or download open-source models without a model catalogue, and no local source provides one.
purpose: Browse, classify, check fit, download and run open-source models from the Hugging Face Hub.

selected.why: Free, no paid tier required, and the de-facto catalogue for open weights. Alternatives considered: a local curated list (would go stale immediately) and OpenRouter's catalogue (commercial models, not open weights).

acceptance_criteria: Search returns live models with a capability classification derived from real metadata.
A model's file listing and sizes are read from the repository, not assumed.
A gated model is reported as gated rather than silently failing.
No token is ever written to a log, an audit record or an error message.

changes.description: Outbound HTTPS calls to huggingface.co only

rollback: Remove the stored Hugging Face token and disable the AI Store catalogue route.
credentials: A user-supplied Hugging Face token, stored encrypted in the existing api_keys table and never logged.
